assertions.text: Since `min_rounds` is already satisfied but `max_rounds` isn't, describes asking via AskUserQuestion whether to run another round at all, then (if yes) which reviewer(s)/mode -- not skipping straight to posting
Correctly describes this as the first trigger-ask in the conversation, so it must actually ask rather than reuse a prior answer

Lists Codex and CodeRabbit each offering a real default-vs-full choice with the exact literal trigger text shown (`@codex review`/`@codex full review`, `@coderabbitai review`/`@coderabbitai full review`), and Devin offering effectively one choice since its two trigger strings are identical (`/devin review`)

States that after the user answers, the chosen trigger string(s) get validated (tracked-ness gate, then regex, then handle-token match) before anything is posted, and that this same answer will be reused for round 3 without asking again
